docs.title: Dual-Embedding (EVA-02 + BLIP-2) — Feature Documentation
docs.text: Status: Production-ready on RTX 2080 Ti (11 GB VRAM) Paper: MemoriEase 3.0: A RAG-Enhanced Conversational Lifelog Retrieval System at LSC'25, §3.2 Date: 2026-06-26

docs.title: 1. Overview
docs.text:
AIC-26 supports a two-stream embedding pipeline that combines two complementary vision-language models for retrieval:

Stream Model Dim Role EVA-02 hf-hub:timm/eva02_large_patch14_clip_224.merged2b_s4b_b131k 768 Joint image+text encoder, ~427 M params, supports native text search BLIP-2 Salesforce/blip2-itm-vit-g (Q-Former + OPT-2.7b) 768 Image-conditioned embedding, ~1.2 B params, ViT-G/E + Q-Former

Both streams store their vectors in separate FAISS IndexFlatIP indexes. At query time the cosine similarities from each stream are blended with a configurable weighted average (EVA02_SEARCH_WEIGHT, BLIP2_SEARCH_WEIGHT), exactly the recipe from §3.2 of the MemoriEase paper:

"We use a weighted average approach to combine the cosine similarity from two embeddings. The weight is chosen by retrieving several queries and tuning the best weight."

Default weights (EVA02_SEARCH_WEIGHT=0.6, BLIP2_SEARCH_WEIGHT=0.4) were chosen by the team after offline tuning on the AIC-26 dev split.

docs.title: 2. Why two streams?
docs.text:
Each model captures different aspects of visual semantics:

  • EVA-02 is a CLIP-style contrastive learner. It produces tight, isotropic embeddings that are well-aligned between image and text in the same space — text-to-image search works directly.
  • BLIP-2 Q-Former is an image-conditioned retrieval head trained with image-text matching. It captures fine-grained visual grounding that CLIP often smooths out, at the cost of weaker text alignment.

Blending them with a weighted average reduces the failure modes of either model used alone.

docs.title: 3.1 Embedding extraction
docs.text:
aic26 pipeline extract-dual-embeddings -i data/keyframes -b 4

Loops over each video folder and writes two .npy files per video (lockstep row order, L2-normalized):

data/embeddings/{video}.npy        # shape (N, 768), EVA-02 image features
data/blip2_embeddings/{video}.npy  # shape (N, 768), BLIP-2 Q-Former features

Resumable: a folder is skipped if both files already exist. On RTX 2080 Ti (batch=4), throughput is ~25–30 s/folder for the full 55-folder × 12,609-image corpus.

docs.title: 3.2 FAISS index build
docs.text:
aic26 pipeline build-dual-index

Stacks the per-video .npy files from both streams into single (12609, 768) arrays, builds two IndexFlatIP indexes, and pickles them together with image/video metadata:

{
    'eva02_index': IndexFlatIP(768),    # 12 609 vectors
    'blip2_index': IndexFlatIP(768),    # 12 609 vectors
    'embeddings':  (12609, 768) float32,  # legacy single-stream copy
    'image_paths': ['K05_V001_converted/000000.jpg', ...],
    'video_names': ['K05_V001_converted', ...],
    'weight_eva02': 0.6,
    'weight_blip2': 0.4,
    'dual': True,
    # ... other keys preserved for compatibility
}

Output: data/faiss_db.pkl (~112 MB).

docs.title: 3.3 Search at query time
docs.text:
The flow is:

  1. Encode the query with EVA-02 (image and text both supported).
  2. Encode the query with BLIP-2 (image only; see §4 for text fallback).
  3. Pull top_k * DUAL_SEARCH_POOL_MULTIPLIER (default 5×) candidate rows from each stream's FAISS index.
  4. Weighted blend: score[i] = w_eva · sim_eva[i] + w_blip2 · sim_blip2[i].
  5. Take the top-k from the blended pool.

The wider pool per stream is deliberate: if we only pulled top_k from each stream and blended, an image that ranks 11th on EVA-02 but 1st on BLIP-2 could be missed. The paper explicitly recommends this candidate-pool-then-blend pattern.

docs.title: 4. Important caveat: BLIP-2 text branch
docs.text:
The Salesforce/blip2-itm-vit-g checkpoint's Q-Former is image-only:

  • get_qformer_features(pixel_values) accepts no text input.
  • use_qformer_text_input is not exposed on qformer_config for this variant (only on the OPT text_config, which doesn't help).
  • get_text_features(input_ids, attention_mask) exists but returns the language-model embedding (OPT/Flan-T5 side), not the Q-Former embedding — a different space, not directly comparable to image embeddings.

We measured the empirical effect: feeding 8 distinct text queries through the BLIP-2 path (Q-Former + 224×224 black image) produced 8 identical 768-d vectors (pairwise cosine similarity = 1.0000). Adding this constant vector to every row of the EVA-02 stream would dominate the blend and collapse all rankings.

docs.title: 4.1 Runtime detection and fallback
docs.text:
To avoid this failure mode without requiring a code-level branch for every query type, SearchEngine._blip2_text_query_usable() runs a two-query probe at first use:

a = encode_text_blip2("probe query alpha")
b = encode_text_blip2("probe query beta distinct words")
usable = bool(np.linalg.norm(a - b) > 1e-3)

If usable is False, search_text and search_text_all skip the dual blend and use the single-stream EVA-02 path. search_image is unaffected — the BLIP-2 image branch is correctly conditioned on the real query image.

If the BLIP-2 checkpoint is later swapped for a variant that accepts text input (e.g. a captioning checkpoint with use_qformer_text_input=True), the probe will start returning True and the dual blend activates for text queries automatically — no further code change required.

docs.title: 5. Configuration
docs.text:
All knobs live in src/aic26/config/settings.py and read from .env:

USE_DUAL_EMBEDDING=true            # Master switch — when false, single-stream path
EVA02_SEARCH_WEIGHT=0.6            # Weight for EVA-02 cosine similarity in blend
BLIP2_SEARCH_WEIGHT=0.4            # Weight for BLIP-2 cosine similarity in blend
DUAL_SEARCH_POOL_MULTIPLIER=5      # top_k * this pulled from each stream before blending
BLIP2_MODEL_NAME=Salesforce/blip2-itm-vit-g
BLIP2_EMBEDDING_DIR=data/blip2_embeddings

BLIP2_EMBEDDING_DIM=768 is a Final constant in config/constants.py.

ensure_directories() creates data/blip2_embeddings/ on import so the dual path never fails on missing-directory errors.

docs.title: 6. CLI surface
docs.text:
# Offline
aic26 pipeline extract-dual-embeddings -i data/keyframes -b 4
aic26 pipeline build-dual-index

# Online (text, EVA-02 only on this checkpoint)
aic26 search text -q "a red car driving on a highway" -k 10

# API (same logic)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/search_text \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"a person riding a bicycle", "top_k":10}'

docs.title: 7. API & GUI wiring
docs.text:
• EVA02ImageRetrieval(blip2_dir=...) (core/retrieval.py) is the single facade. Setting blip2_dir=None falls back to single-stream behavior automatically.
  • api/server.py::_init_retriever reads settings.blip2_embedding_dir and passes it through. The retriever is still lazy-loaded on first request — models do not sit in VRAM until needed.
  • Both Flask routes and the CustomTkinter GUI go through the facade, so no per-interface changes were needed.
  • data/faiss_db.pkl is backward-compatible: old single-stream pickles still load — the retriever simply skips BLIP-2 and logs that single-stream mode is active.

docs.title: 8. Performance numbers (RTX 2080 Ti 11 GB)
docs.text:
Step Throughput Wall time Dual extraction (12,609 imgs, batch=4) ~8 imgs/s 25 min Dual index build n/a <1 s Search text (single-stream fallback) — ~60 ms / query Search image (full dual blend, top-25 pool) — ~200 ms / query

Peak VRAM with both models resident (EVA-02 + BLIP-2): ~9.6 GB. Set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True to reduce fragmentation if you see OOM on a tighter budget.

docs.title: Điểm chính
docs.text: LSC (Lifelog Search Challenge) là benchmark dài hạn duy nhất đánh giá hệ thống retrieval tương tác real-time qua human-in-the-loop. Khác với TRECVID / VBS / ImageCLEF (offline asynchronous), LSC chạy live với assessors.

docs.title: Dataset
docs.text:
• 725K ảnh first-person từ Narrative Clip, 1024×768, 18 tháng (Jan 2019 – Jun 2020)
  • Metadata mỗi phút: timestamp, activity, biometrics (heart-rate, steps, sleep), GPS
  • Visual concepts: COCO objects (80 classes) + Places365 scenes (102 labels)
  • OCR + bounding box + confidence
  • Semantic location names ("Home", "Dublin City University")
  • Flight metadata (Voxento team)

docs.title: 3 loại task
docs.text: Task Query Time Score KIS (Known-Item Search) text mô tả progressing qua các hint 30s 300s max(0, 100 − 50·t/T − 10·w) Ad-hoc free-text, không có ground truth 180s 100 × correct/(correct+incorrect/2) × correct/total QA câu hỏi tự do → text answer 180s Correctness judged by assessors, penalty cho incorrect

docs.title: Evolution của hệ thống
docs.text:
• LSC'22: CLIP zero-shot lên ngôi (MyScéal, LifeSeeker 4.0, Memento 2.0, Vitrivr-VR, EAGLE, Voxento, FIRST, vitrivr).
  • LSC'23: text-image embedding trên hầu hết các hệ thống; temporal + spatial filtering phổ biến.
  • LSC'24: tích hợp metadata, concept, temporal reasoning; Llama-based reranking.

docs.title: Paradigm shift
docs.text:
[2018-2021] rule-based / keyword filter
   ↓
[2022+] embedding-driven (CLIP family) + FAISS vector index
   ↓
[2024+] LLM-driven retrieval + RAG (MemoriEase 3.0) + multimodal (image+text+sketch)

docs.title: Bài học rút ra cho AIC-26
docs.text:
1. Multimodal input handling quan trọng — combine text query + image + metadata filters.
  2. Temporal reasoning (TRAKE-style DP) đã thành standard cho KIS/QA.
  3. Real-time interaction (sub-second response) là yếu tố cạnh tranh.
  4. Object filter + OCR + semantic location là ba filter "must-have".
  5. Score formula phạt wrong submissions — nên có UI giúp user refine, không spam.

docs.title: Temporal search
docs.text:
Query phức tạp kiểu "man with red shirt -o person|position:top-left < plane flight <-h 120+" được tách thành nhiều block. Mỗi block tìm 5000 FAISS results → lọc qua MongoDB bounding box → ghép theo thời gian.

Heart-rate filter tự động kích hoạt khi trong query có giá trị số > 120.

docs.title: Kết quả Recall@K (text embedding benchmark)
docs.text: OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 (LAION2B) đạt Recall@1 = 0.7, @10 = 0.8, @100 = 0.9 trên LSC'2023 textual queries. Tốt nhất trong các model được thử.

docs.title: Bài học rút ra cho AIC-26
docs.text:
1. OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 (LAION2B) là baseline mạnh — AIC-26 dùng EVA-02 (1024-dim) nên phong phú hơn về dim.
  2. Image-as-Query cho phép user cung cấp thêm hint qua URL/upload/drag — AIC-26 đã có (/api/upload_image).
  3. Temporal query composition bằng cách chia thành nhiều query part rồi ghép theo thời gian — giống cơ chế TRAKE trong AIC-26 nhưng khác ở chỗ: lifeXplore ghép qua MongoDB key-time, AIC-26 dùng DP.
  4. Bounding box + position filter — YOLOv7 COCO 80 categories. AIC-26 dùng YOLOv8x OIV7 (600+ categories) phong phú hơn nhiều.
  5. WebSocket cho frontend thay vì polling — AIC-26 dùng HTTP REST (Flask), đơn giản hơn nhưng có thể cải tiến.

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text:
FRAMES (725,226) → KEYFRAMES (397,101) → SHOTS (~205K)
                              ↓                ↓
                     L2 feature distance   Roaring Bitmaps
                     (consecutive frames    (weekday filter)
                      merged if similar)

docs.title: Keyframe + Shot Detection
docs.text:
• Tính L2 distance giữa feature vector của các frame liên tiếp.
  • Nếu nhỏ hơn threshold → merge thành 1 keyframe (lấy highest contrast).
  • Sau khi có keyframes → so sánh keyframe đầu tiên của shot với keyframe cuối của shot trước → chia shot.
  • 725K frames → 397K keyframes → ~205K shots.

docs.title: Search capabilities
docs.text:
• Text search: CLIP offline — feature server chạy GPU, query online trên CPU.
  • Image search: upload/drag → server tạo embedding → ANN search.
  • OCR: BM25 + alpha slider (0 = image, 1 = OCR text).
  • Hybrid: combine text + image + OCR với slider weights.

docs.title: Models đã thử
docs.text:
Model Dim Note CLIP (original) 1024 Joint-embedding, contrastive LAIONSB — CLIP loss + auxiliary loss EVA CLIP ViT-E — 5B params, lớn nhất vision-language open-source

Best VBS: EVA CLIP ViT-E joint-embedding + LAIONSB loss → quantized to 1536-dim + binarize ở range [0, 255] → dùng Hamming distance thay L2/cosine → memory chỉ 192 bytes/image. Tốc độ tăng ~100×.

docs.title: Roaring Bitmap filters
docs.text:
Filter mask cho mỗi metadata field: - Weekday filter (Sat+Sun UNION). - Biometric (heart-rate range). - Location (city/country). - Visual concept (Places365). - Date range.

Mỗi filter → Roaring Bitmap → AND operation trong milliseconds.

docs.title: User Interface
docs.text: 3 panels: 1. Query formulation (trái): text/image/OCR input + sliders + filters. 2. Search area (giữa): scan-line grid (FLAS algorithm) — most relevant ở giữa. 3. Global map (phải trên): 2D grid visualization của proximity graph — clustering tự nhiên. 4. Temporal view (phải dưới): slideshow ngày của ảnh hiện tại.

docs.title: Bài học rút ra cho AIC-26
docs.text:
1. Keyframe extraction giảm search space 50% — AIC-26 dùng DINOv2 cosine similarity cho keyframe detection (pipeline/keyframe.py).
  2. Quantized embedding + Hamming tăng tốc 100× so với L2/cosine — cơ hội tối ưu hóa cho AIC-26 nếu scale lên hàng triệu frames.
  3. EVA CLIP ViT-E joint-embedding với LAIONSB loss → AIC-26 cũng dùng EVA-02 nhưng chưa fine-tune joint-embedding.
  4. Roaring Bitmap cho filter — nhanh hơn so với query DB mỗi lần.
  5. FLAS algorithm cho scan-line grid arrangement → có thể áp dụng cho hiển thị kết quả GUI.

docs.title: 4. MemoriEase 3.0 — RAG-Enhanced Conversational Retrieval
docs.text: File: paper/3729459.3748689.pdf — ACM ICMR / LSC'25. Tác giả: Tran, Nguyen, Jones, Gurrin (DCU + VNU-HCM). Đây là paper nền tảng cho kiến trúc dual-embedding của AIC-26 — đặc biệt là §3.2 và cơ chế "weighted average of CLIP + BLIP2 cosine similarity".

docs.title: Dual embedding §3.2 (CRITICAL cho AIC-26)
docs.text:
"We extract image embeddings using the BLIP2 and CLIP models. [...] query is encoded into embeddings by two models (CLIP and BLIP2). The embeddings are used to calculate the cosine similarity from image embeddings. We use a weighted average approach to combine the cosine similarity from two embeddings. The weight is chosen for retrieving several queries and tuning the best weight."

→ Đây chính là EVA02_SEARCH_WEIGHT * sim_eva02 + BLIP2_SEARCH_WEIGHT * sim_blip2 trong core/search.py::_dual_topk_indices của AIC-26.

docs.title: Các cải tiến so với MemoriEase 2.0
docs.text:
1. Dual embedding (CLIP + BLIP2) — chính là core của §3.2 mô tả.
  2. Enhanced Relevance Feedback — trước: dùng pooled image average. Sau: dùng query embedding + pooled image embedding với weight balance để retain original query info.
  3. RAG cho QA task — cross-encoder BERT rerank descriptions, format <metadata><description> prompt cho GPT-o1.
  4. KIS score cải thiện 10 điểm — nhờ query embedding retention.
  5. AD-HOC không cải thiện — vì cùng cơ chế visual similarity search.

docs.title: BLIP2 image descriptions
docs.text:
• Sinh caption tự động từ BLIP2 (Salesforce/blip2-itm-vit-g).
  • Lưu thêm vào index → filter/re-rank theo description relevance.
  • ⚠️ AIC-26 gotcha: Salesforce/blip2-itm-vit-g chỉ nhận image input cho Q-Former, text phải dùng black 224×224 placeholder (xem memory [[blip2-itm-vit-g-image-only]]). Đã có runtime probe fallback trong core/search.py (xem [[dual-embedding-text-fallback]]).

docs.title: Bài học rút ra cho AIC-26
docs.text:
1. §3.2 weighted average hai embedding — đã implement trong AIC-26, kiểm chứng giả thuyết từ paper này.
  2. Pooled image embedding ≠ original query info — phải weight lại với query embedding (relevance feedback cải tiến).
  3. BLIP2 Q-Former image-only — phải fallback cho text-only query (memory [[blip2-itm-vit-g-image-only]]).
  4. Cross-encoder BERT rerank — AIC-26 dùng BLIP ITM rerank thay vì BERT. Khác nhưng cùng paradigm.
  5. RAG cho QA — nếu AIC-26 mở rộng sang QA task, có thể mượn cơ chế description → prompt → GPT này.

docs.title: 5. SnapSeek 3.0 — Enhanced Scene Understanding
docs.text: File: paper/3729459.3748697.pdf — ACM ICMR / LSC'25. Tác giả: Ho-Le, Ho, Ninh, Nguyen, Gurrin, Tran (VNU-HCM + DCU). Top performer LSC'25 (2nd place overall, 1st place KIS — score 100/100).

docs.title: 4 trụ cột cải tiến từ SnapSeek 2.0
docs.text:
1. Search modalities: semantic, image-based, keyword, hybrid.
  2. Temporal search nâng cao: SeqWin + ParChain.
  3. Human-in-the-loop feedback với A+ / A− update.
  4. Scene graph 3-tuple qua MLLM (Qwen2.5-VL-7B).
  5. ADL (Activities of Daily Living) annotations — 35 classes.

docs.title: Search modalities
docs.text:
• Semantic: CLIP5S text-image → Milvus dense vector.
  • Image-based: upload/URL/cropped → CLIP image embedding.
  • Keyword: location/ADL/OCR indexed as sparse vector trong Milvus.
  • Hybrid: dense + sparse weighted fusion.

→ AIC-26 chỉ có semantic + image + object filter. Keyword/ADL sparse search là cơ hội mở rộng.

docs.title: Step 1: Temporal Clause Extraction (LLM)
docs.text:
LLM prompt-engineered convert text query → JSON: 

{
  "before": <clause_1>,
  "after":  <clause_2>,
  "interval": {"min": x, "max": y}  // null nếu không có
}

Cho phép null interval → linh hoạt cho "arrive at the airport before boarding" (gap không xác định).

docs.title: Step 2: Clause Retrieval
docs.text: Mỗi clause → search stack semantic → top-K ranked lists R1, R2.

docs.title: Step 3: Temporal Consistency Enforcement
docs.text: Hai mode interchangeable:

docs.title: SeqWin (Sequential Windowing)
docs.text:
Cho tightly-coupled temporal queries.

1. Lấy top-K seed frames f1 từ R1 (ranked by sim s1).
2. Với mỗi f1 tại time t_f1, tạo forward window W(f1) = [t_f1, t_f1 + δ]
   với δ = interval.max hoặc user-adjustable.
3. Trong W(f1), xét tất cả frames f2 trong R2 có timestamp ∈ W(f1)
   → tính clause-2 score s2 → chọn frame gần f1 nhất (smallest gap).
4. pair_score = mean(s1, s2)
5. Rank các valid (f1, f2) pairs.

→ Tương đương trake_closest (greedy DP) trong AIC-26 — minimize frame gap.

docs.title: ParChain (Parallel Chain Aggregation)
docs.text:
Cho loosely-coupled / multi-scene queries.

1. Từ R1 và R2, form contexts — chuỗi frame kề nhau trong interval [min, max].
   context = shot (≤ 2s window).
2. score(c) = max(f) trong context.
3. Tạo ordered context pairs (c1, c2) với c1 ∈ R1, c2 ∈ R2
   sao cho start(c2) > end(c1) và gap ∈ [min, max].
4. pair_score = sum(score(c1), score(c2))
5. Rank valid context pairs.

→ Tương đương trake_highest (summed similarity) trong AIC-26.

docs.title: Step 4: Interactive Refinement
docs.text: Slider α ∈ [1..200] re-evaluate SeqWin/ParChain on-the-fly mà không phải re-index.

docs.title: Human Feedback
docs.text:
User mark ảnh relevant / irrelevant. Cập nhật set A:

A ← (A ∪ A⁺) \ A⁻

Mỗi feedback có ít nhất 1 component: relevant set, irrelevant set, hoặc cả hai. Hai-scheme scoring: - A⁺ (positive): similarity = α × original_score + (1−α) × sim_to_relevant - A⁻ (negative): similarity = original_score × sim_to_irrelevant

docs.title: Scene Graphs (NEW in 3.0)
docs.text:
3-tuple representation: 

(subject, predicate, object)

Generated bằng Qwen2.5-VL-7B MLLM với carefully-crafted prompt (lower-case noun, base-form predicates, no passive constructions). Indexed in Milvus alongside image embeddings.

→ Enable both visual + relational search. AIC-26 chưa có scene graph — cơ hội cải tiến lớn.

docs.title: ADL (Activities of Daily Living)
docs.text:
• 35 classes (e.g., "cooking", "commuting", "shopping").
  • 300 representative examples/class.
  • High-quality annotation ≈ 75% dataset.
  • Used để filter/narrow retrieval candidates cho action-related queries.

→ AIC-26 có object detection (YOLOv8x OIV7) nhưng chưa có ADL classification — mở rộng tự nhiên.

docs.title: Results @ LSC'25
docs.text:
• 2nd place overall (SnapSeek1: 2711/3000 = 90.4%)
  • 1st place KIS với SnapSeek2 (100% on some queries)
  • Top 3 trên Ad-hoc

docs.title: Bài học rút ra cho AIC-26
docs.text:
1. SeqWin ≡ trake_closest, ParChain ≡ trake_highest — AIC-26 đã implement nhưng còn đơn giản. Có thể nâng cấp:
  2. Explicit interval [min, max] parsing (dùng LLM hoặc regex).
  3. Forward window thay vì exhaustive DP (nhanh hơn).
  4. Context = shot (window theo shot, không phải per-frame).
  5. α slider re-evaluate on-the-fly — đáng thêm vào GUI: refine temporal results mà không cần re-search.
  6. Scene graph 3-tuple qua MLLM — feature chưa có trong AIC-26. Có thể tích hợp Qwen2.5-VL-7B nếu có GPU đủ mạnh (RTX 2080 Ti chỉ có 11GB → có thể chạy quantized).
  7. ADL classification — bổ sung cho action queries. Pipeline tương tự YOLOv8x.
  8. Milvus thay FAISS — nếu scale lên > 1M embeddings, Milvus có GPU index và distributed. Hiện tại AIC-26 dùng FAISS IndexFlatIP (CPU) đủ cho ~700K vectors.
  9. LLM clause extraction — quan trọng cho query parsing. Nếu thêm LLM step (GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3) có thể boost temporal search accuracy.

docs.title: Roadmap cải tiến tiềm năng cho AIC-26
docs.text: Dựa trên các paper, đây là những cải tiến có giá trị cao:

docs.title: Ngắn hạn (low-hanging fruit)
docs.text:
1. Temporal interval parsing: parse (min, max) từ query text thay vì chỉ dùng GAP_KEYFRAME cố định (từ SnapSeek 3.0).
  2. Query embedding retention trong relevance feedback: thay vì chỉ filter bằng object, mix pooled image embedding với query embedding (từ MemoriEase 3.0 §3.5).
  3. Binarized embedding cho large-scale: nếu > 1M frames → quantize EVA-02 về [0,255] + Hamming (từ Libro).
  4. Hybrid sparse + dense search: thêm BM25/keyword layer cho OCR text (từ SnapSeek 3.0).

docs.title: Trung hạn
docs.text:
1. Scene graph generation: dùng Qwen2.5-VL-7B quantized để sinh 3-tuple (subject, predicate, object) cho mỗi keyframe (từ SnapSeek 3.0 §3.5).
  2. Cross-encoder reranker: thay BLIP ITM bằng BERT cross-encoder trên query-description pairs (từ MemoriEase 3.0 §3.4).
  3. RAG cho QA: nếu mở rộng sang QA task, dùng GPT-4o-mini + reranked descriptions (từ MemoriEase 3.0 §3.4).

docs.title: Dài hạn
docs.text:
1. Milvus thay FAISS: distributed vector DB cho scale > 1M embeddings.
  2. ADL classification: 35-class ADL pipeline (YOLOv8 + CLIP zero-shot) (từ SnapSeek 3.0 §3.6).
  3. CLIP-based joint-embedding fine-tune: train EVA-02 với LAIONSB loss (joint embedding + binarize) — nhưng cần GPU > 24GB.

docs.title: Citation / tham chiếu nhanh
docs.text:
Khi implement feature mới dựa trên paper, cite trong commit message và docstring:

# Ví dụ trong core/search.py
def dual_topk_indices(...):
    """Weighted average of two embedding streams.

    Implements the dual-embedding retrieval strategy from:
    MemoriEase 3.0 (Tran et al., LSC'25) §3.2:
        "weighted average approach to combine the cosine similarity
         from two embeddings (CLIP and BLIP2)"
    """
    score = EVA02_SEARCH_WEIGHT * sim_eva02 + BLIP2_SEARCH_WEIGHT * sim_blip2

docs.title: AD-1: MLLM runtime chọn transformers + bitsandbytes, không dùng vLLM
docs.text:
Context: Qwen2.5-VL-7B cần ~14GB FP16, RTX 2080 Ti chỉ có 11GB.

Options considered: - A. transformers + bitsandbytes 4-bit (~5GB) ← chọn - B. vLLM — nhanh hơn 10-20× nhưng cần GPU ≥ 24GB (không khả thi) - C. ollama — đơn giản nhưng thêm dependency runtime, khó debug

Decision: A. Trade-off: chậm hơn vLLM (~2-5s/keyframe thay vì 0.3s) nhưng chạy được trên hardware hiện tại.

docs.title: AD-2: Places365 inference wrapper độc lập, không qua pipeline/detection.py
docs.text:
Context: YOLOv8x OIV7 detect object bbox; Places365 classify scene category. Hai tác vụ khác nhau.

Options considered: - A. Module riêng pipeline/places365.py ← chọn - B. Mở rộng pipeline/detection.py thêm scene classification

Decision: A. Tách rời để dễ test, dễ swap model sau này (vd: chuyển sang CLIP zero-shot scene). detection.py chỉ thêm field position (low-risk extension).

docs.title: AD-3: Scene graph JSON key = scene_graph, structure = array of objects
docs.text:
Context: paper SnapSeek dùng <sub><pred><obj> text; AIC-26 cần structured.

Schema: 

{
  "detections": [{"label": "person", "score": 0.92, "bbox": [10, 20, 100, 200], "position": "top-left"}],
  "scene": {"category": "kitchen", "confidence": 0.85, "top5": [...]},
  "scene_graph": [{"s": "person", "p": "hold", "o": "cup", "confidence": 0.9}]
}

Decision: 3 keys top-level. Backward-compatible (nếu field = null, downstream xử lý OK).

docs.title: Risks & Mitigations
docs.text: # Risk Impact Mitigation R1 Qwen2.5-VL-7B không load được trên RTX 2080 Ti 11GB dù 4-bit High — blocker Fallback sang SmolVLM-Instruct (256M params, chạy FP16 thoải mái) hoặc BLIP-2 ITM (đã có sẵn). Detect tại runtime: nếu OOM → log warning + skip scene_graph + để fields = null. R2 Places365 weights download chậm hoặc fail mirror Medium — blocker download Use official MIT-CSAIL URL http://places.csail.mit.edu/.... Nếu fail: skip scene classification, return null. R3 Qwen output không phải JSON hợp lệ (model hallucinate) Medium — silent corrupt Robust JSON parser: regex extract JSON block, retry 1 lần với temperature=0. Log bad outputs. R4 Memory leak khi batch process 1000+ keyframes với Qwen Medium — OOM after N frames Batch size = 1 cho Qwen (giữ model ở GPU giữa các frames), explicit torch.cuda.empty_cache() mỗi 50 frames. R5 Bbox position ambiguous khi object rất nhỏ Low — bad UX Skip position cho bbox width/height < 5% image size. Return null. R6 JSON sidecar size lớn (scene_graph có thể 10 triples × fields = ~500 bytes × 50K = 25MB) Low — disk Acceptable. Nếu cần compact: dùng msgpack hoặc flatten thành CSV.

  "video": "K05_V004",
  "frame_idx": 42,
  "detections": [
    {
      "label": "Person",
      "score": 0.92,
      "bbox": [10, 20, 100, 200],

  ],

    "category": "airport_terminal",

    "top5": [["airport_terminal", 0.633], ["indoor", 0.185]],
    "smoothed_category": "airport_terminal"

Quy tắc backward-compat: - detections: luôn emit (mặc định []). - scene: null khi chưa chạy, {...} khi đã chạy. - scene_graph: [] khi chưa chạy hoặc ran-but-empty. - ocr_text: null khi chưa merge, [{...}] sau merge. - caption: null khi chưa chạy, "" (chuỗi rỗng) khi model thất bại — phân biệt với model chưa chạy.

docs.text: Status: Draft v1 Date: 2026-06-26 Owner: AIC-26 team Related papers: docs/paper-knowledge.md §5 (SnapSeek 3.0) + §2 (lifeXplore)

docs.title: Objective
docs.text:
Trích xuất metadata phong phú cho mỗi keyframe trong data/keyframes/, kết hợp: - Hướng SnapSeek 3.0 (Paper #5): scene graph 3-tuple (subject, predicate, object) qua MLLM. - Hướng lifeXplore (Paper #2): bounding box position (mở rộng YOLOv8x output) + semantic concept (Places365 scene recognition).

Mục tiêu cụ thể:

  1. Cho phép query filter theo vị trí object trong ảnh (-o person|position:top-left).
  2. Cho phép query filter theo scene category (-c "kitchen").
  3. Cho phép query filter theo quan hệ giữa objects (-r "person holding cup").
  4. Không thay đổi EVA-02 embedding pipeline hiện tại — chỉ thêm metadata sidecar.
  5. MVP trên 1-2 video đầu tiên để verify pipeline, chưa scale toàn bộ.

User stories:

  • Là người dùng tìm kiếm, tôi muốn gõ "a person on the left holding a cup" và hệ thống lọc ra frame có person ở nửa trái ảnh và person trong quan hệ holding với cup.
  • Là người dùng tìm kiếm, tôi muốn gõ "in a kitchen" và hệ thống lọc scene Places365 = kitchen.
  • Là dev, tôi muốn load metadata của 1 keyframe trong < 5ms qua KeyframeMetadata.load(video, frame_idx).

docs.title: Tech Stack
docs.text: Layer Choice Lý do MLLM (scene graph) Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct quantized 4-bit (BitsAndBytes) RTX 2080 Ti 11GB không chạy nổi FP16; 4-bit ≈ 5GB. Theo SnapSeek §3.5 dùng Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Object detector (bbox) YOLOv8x-OIV7 (đã có) Mở rộng thêm position field. Đã có trong pipeline/detection.py. Scene recognition EfficientNet-B2 pretrained Places365 (từ lifeXplore §3 Table 1) Nhẹ (~9MB), chạy CPU được, ~365 scene classes. Paper lifeXplore dùng đúng model này. Storage JSON-per-keyframe Mirror data/detections/{video_name}/{frame_idx}.json pattern. Pipeline integration Click subcommand aic26 pipeline extract-metadata Đặt cạnh extract-keyframes, extract-embeddings. Config Mở rộng config/constants.py + Settings (Pydantic) Theo CLAUDE.md "constants are Final, add new knobs to Settings instead".

docs.title: Code Style
docs.text:
Một ví dụ đại diện cho module con (scene_graph.py):

"""Scene graph extraction via Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

Implements the 3-tuple (subject, predicate, object) representation
from SnapSeek 3.0 §3.5 (LSC'25). Output is JSON-serializable.

Why: enable relational queries like "person holding cup" without
relying on CLIP embedding to capture object interactions.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

from PIL import Image

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Lower-case noun, base-form predicates, no passive constructions (SnapSeek §3.5 prompt rules)
SCENE_GRAPH_PROMPT: Final[str] = """Analyze this image and list all visible subject-predicate-object triples.

Rules:
- Use lowercase nouns for subjects and objects (e.g., 'person', 'cup', 'table')
- Use base-form verbs for predicates (e.g., 'hold', 'sit on', 'next to', 'in front of')
- Avoid passive constructions
- Only describe triples you can clearly see
- Limit to the top 5 most salient triples

Output format (JSON only, no commentary):
{"triples": [["subject", "predicate", "object"], ...]}"""

MODEL_NAME: Final[str] = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct"


def extract_scene_graph(image: Image.Image, model) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Extract (subject, predicate, object) triples from one image.

    Args:
        image: PIL Image, RGB, any size.
        model: Loaded Qwen2.5-VL-7B pipeline.

    Returns:
        Up to 5 (subject, predicate, object) tuples, lowercase.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If model output is not valid JSON.
    """
    messages = [
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {"type": "image", "image": image},
                {"type": "text", "text": SCENE_GRAPH_PROMPT},
            ],
        }
    ]
    response = model.chat(messages, max_new_tokens=512)

    try:
        data = json.loads(response)
        triples = [tuple(t) for t in data["triples"]]
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        logger.warning("Bad scene graph output: %s", response)
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid scene graph JSON: {exc}") from exc

    return triples[:5]


def save_scene_graph(path: Path, triples: list[tuple[str, str, str]]) -> None:
    """Persist triples to JSON sidecar matching the detection format."""
    payload = {"scene_graph": [{"s": s, "p": p, "o": o} for s, p, o in triples]}
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

Key conventions:

  • Module-level Final[str] for prompts & magic strings.
  • from __future__ import annotations cho clean type hints.
  • Triple được normalize thành lowercase trước khi lưu.
  • Module docstring cite paper section.
  • Functions nhỏ, single-purpose, dễ test.
  • logger.warning thay vì raise trên malformed model output (recoverable).

  • Thay đổi pipeline/detection.py (existing module) — chỉ thêm field, không sửa logic cũ.
  • Tăng default batch size (ảnh hưởng VRAM).
  • Thay đổi format JSON sidecar (breaking change cho downstream code).

docs.title: Never do
docs.text:
• Modify EVA-02 embedding pipeline (core/embeddings.py, pipeline/embedding.py).
  • Re-train Qwen hoặc Places365 — chỉ inference.
  • Save model weights vào repo (chỉ tên + cache).
  • Skip validation khi gặp bad output — luôn handle gracefully.
  • Auto-commit khi CI đang fail.

docs.title: MVP (1-2 ngày)
docs.text:
• aic26 pipeline extract-metadata --input data/keyframes --output data/metadata chạy thành công trên 1 video (≥ 50 keyframes).
  • Mỗi keyframe có JSON sidecar chứa 3 fields: detections, scene, scene_graph.
  • pytest tests/unit/ pass ≥ 80% coverage cho module mới.
  • verify-metadata --video L01_V001 --frame-idx 42 in ra JSON đẹp, dễ đọc.
  • metadata-stats in ra: tổng keyframes, scene category distribution, average scene graph triples/keyframe.
  • Smoke test script chạy được trên 50 keyframes đầu của L01_V001 trong < 5 phút (GPU RTX 2080 Ti).
  • Zero crash khi gặp ảnh corrupt (skip + log warning).

docs.title: Out of scope cho MVP
docs.text:
• ❌ Integration với retrieval pipeline (core/embeddings.py đọc metadata để filter).
  • ❌ Scale toàn bộ data/keyframes/ (chỉ chạy 1-2 video).
  • ❌ ADL classification (35 classes) — quyết định chỉ scene graph.
  • ❌ Roaring Bitmaps filter (đề xuất từ Libro).
  • ❌ UI mới trong Flask GUI để filter theo scene/position/relation.

docs.title: Stretch (sau MVP)
docs.text:
• Add filter -r "person holding cup" vào core/search.py::_filter_by_scene_graph.
  • Add filter -c kitchen vào search.
  • Add position filter -o person|position:top-left.
  • Integration test với end-to-end retrieval: query có filter → recall top-10 có ≥ 8 relevant.

docs.title: Open Questions
docs.text:
1. Qwen2.5-VL-7B quantization: 4-bit (bitsandbytes) hay AWQ? 4-bit đơn giản hơn, AWQ nhanh hơn nhưng cần thêm setup. → Default: bitsandbytes 4-bit. Tune sau nếu quá chậm.

  2. Scene graph cache: nếu chạy lại pipeline, có cần skip frames đã có scene_graph? → Default: skip nếu JSON đã có field scene_graph (idempotent re-run).

  3. Bounding box position grid: 3×3 (top-left, top, top-right, left, center, right, bottom-left, bottom, bottom-right) hay chỉ 4 góc? → Default: 3×3 cho granular hơn.

  4. Places365 model hosting: download về models/places365/ (gitignored) hay dùng torchvision pretrained? → Default: download 1 lần qua aic26 download places365, cache vào models/places365/.

  5. Output format JSON scene_graph: array of objects [{s,p,o}, ...] hay array of arrays [[s,p,o], ...]? → Default: object form dễ đọc hơn, dễ extend thêm field sau.

docs.title: Verification Checklist (trước khi merge)
docs.text:
• pre-commit run --all-files pass.
  • pytest -m "not slow and not gpu" pass.
  • pytest --cov=aic26.pipeline.metadata --cov-report=term-missing ≥ 80%.
  • aic26 pipeline metadata-stats chạy được trên output thật.
  • docs/paper-knowledge.md có link đến spec này ở mục SnapSeek / lifeXplore.
  • README.md có dòng về extract-metadata subcommand (optional, có thể bỏ qua MVP).
